title: A Comprehensive Survey of Wireless Foundation Models for AI-Native 6G Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.14694v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models are emerging as a transformative paradigm for AI-native sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks by enabling scalable, transferable, and data-efficient intelligence across diverse communication tasks. Unlike conventional deep learning models that are trained for individual applications, wireless foundation models (WFMs) learn generalized representations from large-scale heterogeneous wireless data and can be efficiently adapted to communication, sensing, localization, and network optimization tasks with minimal task-specific supervision. translated_title: 面向AI原生6G网络的无线基础模型综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14694v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基础模型正作为AI原生第六代（6G）无线网络的变革性范式出现，通过在不同通信任务中实现可扩展、可迁移和数据高效的智能。与针对单个应用训练的传统深度学习模型不同，无线基础模型（WFMs）从大规模异构无线数据中学习通用表示，并能以最少的任务特定监督高效适应通信、感知、定位和网络优化任务。尽管进展迅速，当前研究在架构、训练范式和应用程序领域仍显分散，缺乏专门针对WFMs设计、学习和部署的统一综述。本综述提供了无线基础模型的全面且统一的回顾。我们首先确立WFMs的基本概念，并引入一种分类法来组织这些概念。
tldr: 本文首次系统综述了无线基础模型在6G网络中的设计、学习与部署，提出统一分类框架，以解决当前研究碎片化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first unified survey on wireless foundation models for 6G networks, proposing a taxonomy to address fragmented research across design, learning, and deployment.
